steps.code:
# Let's compute for each playlist: which songs are downloaded and total duration
downloaded_map = {song['song_id']: song['duration'] for song in downloaded_all}

for pl in playlists:
    pl_id = pl['playlist_id']
    title = pl['title']
    song_ids = pl['song_ids']
    downloaded_in_pl = [sid for sid in song_ids if sid in downloaded_map]
    total_duration = sum(downloaded_map[sid] for sid in downloaded_in_pl)
    all_downloaded = len(downloaded_in_pl) == len(song_ids)
    print(f"Playlist {pl_id} '{title}': {len(downloaded_in_pl)}/{len(song_ids)} songs downloaded, total duration {total_duration}s, all_downloaded={all_downloaded}")
